image_description: A red lionfish (Pterois volitans) swimming near a rocky, algae-covered seabed. The fish displays characteristic vertical reddish-brown and white stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays, and prominent dorsal spines. The lighting is somewhat dim, typical of underwater photography, with some particulate matter in the water.
